plain: The ordered list of steps an attacker must all complete to cause a harm, so blocking any one step stops it.
eli5: To steal the cookies you must find the jar, climb the counter and open the lid: block any one and no cookies.
technical: A decomposition of a harm into necessary sequential stages (from security practice, e.g. reconnaissance to action on objectives) used to find the stage where a prevent, detect or constrain control gives the most risk reduction per cost.
